facebook.author: AnthropicAI
facebook.text: Claude Skills: composable, reusable capabilities you can share across teams. Define a skill once — coding, research, data analysis — and plug it into any Claude workflow. Community skill library launching next month.

facebook.author: AnthropicAI
facebook.text: Claude 4 Opus is here — our most intelligent model, now with extended thinking, computer use, and tool use capabilities. Claude can now manage multi-step workflows, run code, and reason through complex tasks autonomously.

facebook.author: AIatMicrosoft
facebook.text: Microsoft Copilot Studio: create custom AI agents for your enterprise — no code required. Connect to your data, define workflows, and deploy intelligent agents that handle customer support, HR, and IT tasks.

facebook.author: OpenAI
facebook.text: Introducing GPT-5: our most capable model yet. GPT-5 brings native multimodal reasoning, 128K context, and a new coding agent that can build entire projects from a single prompt. Available today for ChatGPT Plus and API users.

facebook.author: DeepMind
facebook.text: Our latest research: Gemini 2.5 Pro achieves state-of-the-art on 30+ benchmarks. New advances in long-context reasoning, scientific discovery, and multimodal understanding. Read the full paper on arXiv.

facebook.author: MetaAILabs
facebook.text: Llama 4 is now open-source and available for download. With 405B parameters, vision capabilities, and 256K context window — the most powerful open model ever released. Fine-tune it, deploy it, build with it.

facebook.author: AnthropicAI
facebook.text: Responsible Scaling Policy update: we've audited Claude 4's capabilities against our ASL-4 threat model. New evaluations show significant improvements in safety without compromising capability. Full report on our website.

facebook.author: OpenAI
facebook.text: Sora is now available to all users — generate cinematic-quality videos from text. New features include scene editing, audio generation, and 1080p output. Create AI-powered stories like never before.

facebook.author: GoogleAI
facebook.text: Project Astra: your AI assistant that can see, hear, and help in real-time. Today we're opening the API to all developers. Build multimodal AI agents that understand the world through your camera.

facebook.author: GoogleAI
facebook.text: Veo 2 video generation is available in public preview. Create 4K, 60fps video clips with physics-aware rendering and consistent character identity. API access opens to all developers this quarter.

facebook.author: OpenAI
facebook.text: Operator is now generally available — your AI agent that browses the web, fills forms, books flights, and manages tasks autonomously. Built-in guardrails let you review before any action is taken.

facebook.author: OpenAI
facebook.text: DevDay 2026 Recap: Realtime API, new fine-tuning tiers, Structured Outputs GA, and the Agents SDK. Building AI agents just got 10x easier. Watch the full keynote replay on our YouTube channel.

facebook.author: AIatMicrosoft
facebook.text: GitHub Copilot now supports multi-file editing, autonomous code review, and our new Copilot Workspace for planning complex tasks. Shipping faster with AI that understands your entire codebase.

facebook.author: GoogleAI
facebook.text: Gemma 3: our most efficient open model family. From 2B to 70B parameters, optimized for on-device, edge, and cloud deployment. Includes new safety classifiers and instruction-tuned variants.

facebook.author: MetaAILabs
facebook.text: PyTorch 3.0 is here with native distributed training, 4-bit quantization, and the new torch.compile v2 — 3x faster training out of the box. The future of open-source ML infrastructure.

facebook.author: DeepMind
facebook.text: AlphaFold 4 predicts protein interactions with near-experimental accuracy. We've open-sourced the model weights and the full training dataset. Drug discovery will never be the same.

facebook.author: DeepMind
facebook.text: Gemini Nano is now running on over 200 million Android devices. On-device AI for smart replies, summarization, and real-time translation — all without sending data to the cloud.

facebook.author: AIatMicrosoft
facebook.text: Azure AI Foundry: your one-stop platform for building, evaluating, and deploying enterprise AI applications. Now supports 1,800+ models, built-in RAG, and end-to-end monitoring.

facebook.author: MetaAILabs
facebook.text: Segment Anything 2 (SAM 2) is out — real-time object segmentation in video. Track any object across frames with zero-shot泛化能力. Open weights, open dataset, open research.
